title: Sync not working between Samsung Health and Gear S
body:
Managing workout items via Samsung Health app (iPhone6, iOS 11.3) will not make the changes appear at the Gear Sport workout selection. 

Example: At the Health app (ver 1.3.0.041) I manage workout items; hide hiking and add badminton. 

Result: At the Gear Sport workout view, hiking is still at the workout selection, but badminton is not.

Furthermore: 
Updating the version button is not working within the app nor at the Apple store. There is ver 1.4.0 available, but the app is not in update mode although I have older version.

Update on 15.4.2018 to the same topic.
Version update worked, I have now ver 1.4.0.039 installed.
Results: 
1) activity data between 11.4. and 15.4. not visible at the Health app.
2) managing workout items at the Health app > nothing happens at the Gear Sport.

I start to lose faith on Gear Sport. At least it is not suitable for someone who uses iPhone6 and wants to track workout sessions.

Big bugs still to be fixed!
